question: In which state of India from the following is the old bamboo drip irrigation technology still used in the agriculture?
solution:
The correct answer is __Meghalaya.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bamboo drip irrigation system **a very old practice seen in Indian state Meghalaya

 
 
• The bamboo drip irrigation system is a 200-year-old system in Meghalaya.
 
• It is a **system of tapping stream and spring water by using bamboo pipes.**
 
• In a bamboo drip irrigation system** about 18-20 litres of water enters the bamboo pipe system**
 
• **It **gets transported over hundreds of metres, a**nd finally reduces to 20-80 drops per minute at the site of the plant.**
 
• The word Meghalaya means "adobe of clouds.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Innovation in Agricultur**e
 
• **Bee Vectoring Technologies**
 
 
• **Honey bees play a crucial role in U.S. crop production, contributing a staggering $20 billion value**.
 
• To safeguard these essential pollinators and enhance their capabilities, innovations are emerging in the form of agriculture equipment.
 
• **Bee Vectoring Technologies (BVT) harnesses** commercially reared bees to deliver targeted crop controls through pollination.
 
• By using bees to carry environmentally safe pest control powders, BVT eliminates the need for chemical pesticides.
 
• **This approach not only enhances sustainable farming practices but also improves crop yields and soil quality**.
 
• The** system is versatile, and suitable for a wide range of crops, from blueberries to apples**.
 
 
 
• **Precision Agriculture**
 
 
• Precision agriculture is **revolutionizing resource management in farmin**g.
 
• This data-driven approach collects, processes, and analyzes information **to optimize soil quality and productivity**.
 
• By relying on remote sensing systems, drones, robotics, and automation, precision **agriculture allows farmers to make informed decisions that boost resource use efficiency, sustainability, profitability, productivity, and crop quality**.
 
• The **global precision farming market is projected to reach $16.35 billion by 2028,** reflecting a 13.1% compound annual growth rate (CAGR).
 
 
 
• **Indoor Vertical Farming**
 
 
• Indoor vertical farming **offers a solution to limited arable land**.
 
• By stacking crops in a controlled environment, **this technology maximizes yield per unit area.**
 
• Hydroponic and aeroponic systems enable plants to grow without soil, significantly reducing water usage and labour costs.
 
• **Controlled variables such as light, temperature, and water contribute to healthier and larger yields.**
